- 2. Embed Question: Convert user question to a vector using same embedding model
- 3. Vector Search: pgvector finds top-K most similar chunks (cosine similarity)
- 4. Build Prompt: LangChain combines: system prompt + retrieved chunks + user question
- 5. LLM Call: Send final prompt to GPT-4 / Claude / local model
- 6. Return Answer: Stream or return the AI answer, save to messages table
